name: AI Chatbot, Live Chat & Appointment Booking: Smart Chat
author: Instinctor

sections.description:
Visitors arrive when you are busy, closed or asleep. Smart Chat answers them from your own site, in their language, books the appointment against your real calendar, and sends the lead to your phone. Install it, type your email, and it is live in about two minutes. No OpenAI key and no other account.

Free, and it already books

  • 5 bookings a month, against your real availability. Visitors pick an open time and get the confirmation on the spot.
  • 20 automatic AI answers a month, in the language the visitor writes in.
  • Unlimited live chat. You answer from your phone, with push alerts and email.
  • After the 20th answer the chat still takes the visitor’s message and phone number and hands them to you, so no lead is lost.
  • No OpenAI key and no other account. You request one key by email from the settings screen.
  • A small “Powered by Instinctor” credit is shown in the chat.

It knows your site, and keeps up

It reads your pages, posts and products, and re-learns them by itself whenever you publish. You can also tell it, in plain words, what to say and what never to say. Questions it could not answer are listed for you: answer once and it knows from then on.

Every lead reaches your phone

When a visitor leaves a phone number or asks for a person, the conversation reaches your phone with a push alert and what they actually said. Reply from there. Your personal number is never shown to them.

WooCommerce: “where is my order?”

It answers from your real WooCommerce orders, only to the customer who placed them: status, items and tracking number.

Booking anywhere

The Smart Chat Booking block or the [smart_chat_booking] shortcode puts the booking picker on any page.

It can answer your phone too

Instinctor Voice answers your business calls the same way, books, and sends you the summary. Hear it on a real call from the plugin’s settings screen, with no setup.

Unlimited plan: $19.90 a month

  • Unlimited AI answers and unlimited bookings.
  • SMS lead alerts to your phone.
  • Two-way texting with the visitor after they leave your site.

Instinctor Voice ($49.90 a month) also answers your phone calls.

These are the only prices. Details: https://instinctor.com/smart-chat/

Light on your site

The widget loads after your page, so it never holds up what your visitors came to see. It works on any theme and on phones.

One field to set up

There is one setting: your key. What the chat says, your hours, your calendar and where your leads go are managed in your Instinctor dashboard, from your computer or your phone.

External services

This plugin loads the Smart Chat widget from Instinctor, which is the service that provides the chat. The widget cannot be served from your own site: it talks to Instinctor to answer questions, check your availability and deliver messages to you.

What is loaded: https://instinctor.com/embed/chat/v1.js, on every page of your site, once the key is set.

What is sent: the key identifying your account, and the address of the page the visitor is on. When a visitor uses the chat, what they type is sent to Instinctor so it can be answered and passed to you, along with any contact details they choose to give, such as a phone number.

Nothing is sent before a visitor’s browser loads the page, and nothing is sent at all while no key is set.

The settings screen can also create an account for you.
This is one of the other times this plugin contacts Instinctor. If you type your email address
there and ask for a key, the plugin sends that email address and your site
address to https://instinctor.com/api/instinctor/v1/solo/chat-start so the
account can be made and the key returned. It happens only when an
administrator asks for it, never on its own and never from a visitor’s
browser. If you already have a key and paste it instead, this call is never
made.

Site brief: so the assistant can answer questions about your business, the plugin sends a summary of your site to https://instinctor.com/api/instinctor/v1/solo/chat-brief, once after the key is set, again whenever a page, post or product is published or unpublished (at most once every ten minutes), and whenever an administrator clicks “Send my site again”. The summary contains your site name, tagline, the text of your published pages and posts, and, if WooCommerce is active, each product’s name, price and short description. Drafts, private and password-protected pages are never sent. It also carries a secret generated on your site, used only to authenticate the order lookup described below. It is authenticated with your key and is not sent from visitors’ browsers.

Usage: the settings screen asks https://instinctor.com/api/instinctor/v1/solo/chat-usage for this month’s answer and booking counts, the upgrade links and questions the assistant could not answer, sending only your key. It is called when an administrator opens the settings screen or the dashboard, at most once every ten minutes.

Answers: when an administrator types an answer to an unanswered question on the settings screen, the plugin sends your key, the conversation reference and that answer to https://instinctor.com/api/instinctor/v1/solo/chat-answer, so the assistant can use it from then on. It happens only when an administrator saves an answer.

Order lookup (WooCommerce only): the plugin adds a route to your own site, /wp-json/instinctor-smart-chat/v1/order. Instinctor calls it when a visitor in the chat asks about an order and gives their order number and billing email. It only answers requests carrying the secret described above, and only when both the order number and the email match. It returns the order’s status, item names and quantities, total, date and tracking number. Addresses, phone numbers, payment details and order notes are never returned.

Booking block: if you place the Smart Chat Booking block or the [smart_chat_booking] shortcode on a page, visitors’ browsers load https://instinctor.com/embed/booking/v1.js on that page and request the booking picker from https://instinctor.com/embed/booking/boot, sending your key. When a visitor checks times or books, the chosen service, time and the details they enter (such as name, phone number or email) are sent to https://instinctor.com/embed/chat/api so the booking can be made in your calendar. The embedded picker books without payment; no deposit is taken on your site.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings, then Smart Chat.
  3. Paste the key from your Smart Chat email. It starts with ic_site_. Pasting the whole script line works too. No account yet? Type your email on the same screen and the key is created for you.
  4. Open your site. The chat is in the bottom right.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. The free plan has unlimited live chat, 20 automatic AI answers a month and 5 bookings a month, with no time limit. The unlimited plan is $19.90 a month for unlimited answers and bookings, plus SMS alerts and texting.

Do I need an OpenAI key?

No. You do not need an OpenAI key or any other account. Type your email on the settings screen, the key arrives by email, and the chat is live in about two minutes.

What happens after 20 answers?

The chat keeps working. It takes the visitor’s message and phone number and hands them to you in the phone app and by email, so no lead is lost. Answers reset each month.

Does it book appointments?

Yes, on the free plan too. It offers only times that are actually open, books the one the visitor picks and sends the confirmation. The free plan includes 5 bookings a month.

Which languages does it speak?

It answers in the language the visitor writes in, and switches when they do.

Will it slow my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously after your page, so it does not hold up anything a visitor is waiting to see.

Where is my key?

In the email you were sent when you requested it. You can also find it in your dashboard.

Does it work without this plugin?

Yes. The plugin exists so you do not have to paste a script tag into your theme.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • The assistant re-learns the site by itself when you publish or update a page, post or product.
  • New screen listing the questions the assistant could not answer, so you can answer them once and it knows from then on.
  • Answers “where is my order” from your own WooCommerce orders, for the customer who placed them.
  • Appointment booking you can place anywhere: a block, or the [smart_chat_booking] shortcode.
  • Hear the voice assistant answer a call, from the plugin, with no setup.
  • Uninstalling now removes everything the plugin stored, including the secret that authenticates the order lookup.

1.0.2

  • New name and description. No code changes.

1.0.1

  • Review fixes.

1.0.0

  • First release.
